verdict.rationale: OpenHands clearly ships automations: scheduled or webhook-triggered workflows, and Agent Canvas is described as a control center for them. However, nothing in the pack shows versioning, change review, or rollback of automation definitions. Serializable agent settings (docs-33) and SDK-defined agents only imply that configs could be kept in git; they are not a documented automation version or rollback capability, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.
